## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /obj/tiktok_web_login_static/tiktok_privacy_protection_framework/config/network.json` — Get network configuration for TikTok privacy framework.
- `POST /ttwid/check/` — Check the TTWID.
- `POST /v1/user/webid` — Get a web ID for a user.

### Data Read (8)
- `GET /api/{apiId}/item_list/` — Get a list of items for a specific API.
- `GET /api/ba/business/suite/permission/list/` — Get business suite permission list.
- `GET /api/inbox/notice_count/` — Get the number of unread inbox notices.
- `GET /api/user/{userId}/` — Get user information by ID.
- `GET /aweme/v1/report/inbox/notice/` — Get report inbox notices.
- `GET /tiktok/v1/community_notes/intake/check/` — Check intake status of a TikTok community note.
- `GET /tiktok/v1/screen_time/list/` — Retrieve a list of TikTok screen time entries.
- `GET /web/resource` — Get a web resource (data).

### Data Write (5)
- `POST /api/global-footer/graphql` — Post data to the global footer via GraphQL.
- `POST /tiktok/ppf/api/eligibility/v2` — Check eligibility for TikTok PPF.
- `POST /v1/list` — Create a new list.
- `POST /web/report` — Submit a web report.
- `POST /webcast/wallet_api_tiktok/recharge/check_external_entry` — Check external entry for wallet recharge.

### Media (2)
- `GET /_next/image` — Retrieve an image from the platform.
- `POST /tiktok/v1/{v1Id}/upload/` — Upload media to TikTok.

### Config (4)
- `GET /api/share/settings/` — Get sharing settings.
- `GET /api/v1/web-cookie-privacy/config` — Get web cookie privacy configuration.
- `GET /monitor_web/settings/browser-settings` — Get browser settings configuration.
- `POST /service/2/abtest_config/` — Post A/B test configuration.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /tiktok/popup/dispatch/v1` — Dispatch a TikTok popup.
